title: Applicability of This Chapter
previewText:
The regulations of this Chapter shall apply:

to the provision of affordable housing, as set forth in 27-10 (ADMINISTRATION OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING); and to anti-harassment areas, as set forth in 27-20 (ANTI-HARASSMENT).
